$comment: workflow-kit's openrouter node strategy imports llm_scripting_kit (REQUIRED: the node dispatches its model declaration through llm_scripting_kit.declaration.run and needs llm-scripting-kit >= 0.46.0). The edge is declared here so the owning plugin is installed rather than assumed present. bootstrap_lib is REQUIRED too: the loader validates every model: declaration with bootstrap_lib.model_declaration.parse and CORE_IDS, first shipped in bootstrap 0.129.0, which sets requires_bootstrap.
